title: Fiscal settings
productionBoundary: Production is configuration only at this stage. This screen does not enable issuance.
lookupSuccess: Company data found and applied to the form.
lookupError: Company data could not be found for this CNPJ.
cteRetryHint: Sets how many times a failed issuance is retried and how long to wait before each new attempt.
mdfeHint: SEFAZ requires the cargo insurer and the freight bank details when the carrier issues the MDF-e. Leave blank if the company does not issue MDF-e.
billingHint: Details printed on the invoice PDF so the customer knows where to pay. Blank blocks are simply omitted.
billingBankSearchPlaceholder: Search bank by name or code
validationSummaryTitle: Fix the fields below before saving:
saveError: Settings could not be saved. Review the data and try again.
saveErrorCnpjMismatch: The fiscal profile CNPJ must match the active digital certificate CNPJ. Adjust the CNPJ or upload a matching certificate.
logoHint: Image printed on the invoice PDF header. PNG or JPEG up to 256 KB. Without a logo, the PDF prints the legal name only.
removeLogoConfirmation: The logo will be deleted and upcoming invoices will print without a header image.
logoError: Could not save the logo. Code: {{code}}.
logoErrorNetwork: Could not reach the API. Check your internet connection and try again.
logoErrorTooLarge: The image is larger than 256 KB. Reduce the file and try again.
logoErrorUnsupported: Unsupported format. Upload a PNG or JPEG file.
certificatePurposeHint: Each fiscal document keeps its own certificate. Upload the same PFX file once per document the company issues.
certificateMissingForPurpose: No active certificate for this document.
certificateError: Certificate could not be replaced. Code: {{code}}.
certificateErrorForbidden: Your session is not authorized to replace the certificate. Code: {{code}}.
certificateErrorCnpjMismatch: The certificate CNPJ does not match the CNPJ saved in the fiscal profile.
certificateErrorMissingFields: Select the PFX file and enter the certificate password.
certificateErrorNetwork: Could not connect to the API. Check your internet connection and try again.
certificateErrorNotYetValid: This certificate is not valid yet.
certificateErrorProfileMissing: Save the company fiscal profile before uploading the certificate.
certificateErrorRequestFailed: The API did not accept the certificate request. Code: {{code}}.
certificateErrorServer: The API failed while processing the certificate. Code: {{code}}.
certificateErrorStorageUnavailable: The certificate was validated, but the encrypted credential could not be stored. Check the API encryption configuration.
certificateErrorUnsupported: This certificate does not meet the requirements for fiscal signing.
empty: Complete the fiscal profile to prepare future issuance.
error: Settings could not be loaded. Try again.
removeCertificateConfirmation: The certificate will be retired and can no longer be used for signing. History will be preserved.
deleted: Certificate retired. You can now upload a new certificate.
readOnly: You do not have permission to change these settings.
wizardDescription: Before continuing, provide the issuer fiscal data. Digital certificate and issuance environment can be configured later on this same screen.
